Fiscal 2017 compared with fiscal 2016 cos as a percentage of revenues remained consistent year over year. The $ 360 million increase in cos was largely related to our acquisitions and a $ 31 million gain on the sale of certain intangible assets in our gis segment during fiscal 2016 not present in the current fiscal year.
